headline: Arihant Capital Markets Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Arihant Capital Markets Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares or change in control event requiring public disclosure to the stock exchange.
detail: The disclosure filed with NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 is a mandatory filing when a person acquires 25% or more of a company's shares or where a concert party/PAC comes into being. Arihant Capital Markets Limited, a financial services company listed on NSE, has submitted this disclosure, signalling a material shareholding transaction. The exact nature of the transaction, bidder identity, acquisition price, and consideration structure are protected under SEBI confidentiality protocols and typically disclosed in a formal open offer document or announcement thereafter. This is a regulatory gating point for any substantial M&A transaction in India.
